characters.name: Speed King
characters.special_description: Ignites its target from the inside: `110%` damage, then a burn of `25%` damage per turn for `2` turns.

characters.name: Fun Fun Fun
characters.special_description: Pins its target's marks: `80%` damage, stunned (loses its next turn) and `-25%` damage for `2` turns.

characters.name: California King Bed
characters.special_description: Steals a memory from its target: `80%` damage, takes `25%` of its damage for `3` turns and pushes its special back a turn.

characters.name: Born This Way
characters.special_description: Rides in on the frozen wind: every enemy takes `50%` damage and is slowed by `15%` for `2` turns.

characters.name: Les Feuilles
characters.special_description: Wraps leaves around its target: `70%` damage, then poison for `50%` damage per turn and `-20%` speed, both for `3` turns.

characters.name: I Am a Rock
characters.special_description: Pulls everything onto its target: the target is stunned (loses its next turn), every enemy is slowed by `15%` and it gains `+30%` armor, both for `2` turns.

characters.name: Doobie Wah !
characters.special_description: Its tornado follows its target's breath: `150%` damage, then suffocation for `30%` damage per turn for `2` turns.

characters.name: Love Love Deluxe
characters.special_description: Grows hair into its target: `70%` damage, then poison for `35%` damage per turn and `-25%` armor, both for `2` turns.

characters.name: Schott Key n°1
characters.special_description: Explodes: every enemy takes `70%` damage.

characters.name: Schott Key n°2
characters.special_description: Explodes: every enemy takes `70%` damage.

characters.name: Vitamine C
characters.special_description: Softens everything: every enemy loses `20%` speed, damage and armor for `2` turns.

characters.name: Walking Heart
characters.special_description: Stabs its target with its heels for `140%` damage and gains `+15%` damage for `2` turns.

characters.name: Milagro Man
characters.special_description: Curses its target with endless money: true damage equal to `60%` of the target's own damage, then poison worth `40%` of that per turn for `2` turns.

characters.name: Blue Hawaii
characters.special_description: Takes control of its target: stunned (loses its next turn) and poisoned for `35%` damage per turn for `2` turns.

characters.name: Brain Storm
characters.special_description: Folds the pages: every enemy takes `60%` damage and bleeds for `20%` damage per turn for `2` turns.

characters.name: Ozon Baby
characters.special_description: Raises the air pressure: every enemy loses `16%` of its current health and is slowed by `15%` for `2` turns.

characters.name: Doctor Wu
characters.special_description: Infiltrates its target's body: `80%` damage, then poison for `40%` damage per turn and `-20%` armor, both for `3` turns.

characters.name: Awaking III Leaves
characters.special_description: Pins its target with arrows: stunned (loses its next turn) and slowed by `25%` for `2` turns.

characters.name: Wonder of U
characters.special_description: Calamity: every enemy loses `8%` of its max health as true damage, or `16%` if it is below half health, stunned or slowed.

characters.name: Space Trucking
characters.special_description: Stretches its arms: every enemy takes `70%` damage, and it gains `+20%` speed for `2` turns.

characters.name: Victorious Star Platinum
characters.special_description: Stops time and strikes every enemy for `75%` damage.

characters.name: dummy
characters.special_description: Shrugs it off: heals `3%` of its max health. Sudden death still wears it down, if your team lasts long enough.
